about.intro: I’m Lucas, and I’ve been passionate about games since childhood. They sparked my curiosity about the world of technology. Over the years, this interest grew beyond the screen into an increasing desire to understand how systems work and what lies behind each application. This curiosity led me to programming, where I found the opportunity to move from simply using technology to taking part in its creation.
about.bio: I’m a technology enthusiast and software engineer in training, passionate about turning ideas into creative, functional solutions. I’m constantly exploring new technologies, improving my skills, and seeking challenges that help me grow as a developer. I believe programming goes beyond writing code: it’s about solving problems, creating experiences, and turning possibilities into reality.
